schema: fab-checklist-v5 rows; every cell is {value, verdict, reason, source}. No blanks, no TBD.

verdict_rules.copper: PASS iff the stackup matches the board's declared weight on every copper layer
verdict_rules.min_track: PASS iff min track >= the rule for the declared weight (1 oz 0.100, 4 oz 0.250)
verdict_rules.min_space: PASS iff the MINIMUM measured clearance >= the rule for the declared weight; the pair count is never charged (it does not reproduce)
verdict_rules.min_drill: PASS iff min via drill >= 0.200 (no HDI) AND min PTH drill >= the finished-hole floor (0.200 at 1 oz, 0.300 at 4 oz)
verdict_rules.min_ring: PASS iff the smallest ring >= the published floor for the weight; WAIVED iff below that floor but at or above the board's own rule, priced as a quote line
verdict_rules.nonthrough: PASS iff blind + buried == 0, classified by LAYER PAIR (span), never by drill diameter or declared type
verdict_rules.unconnected: PASS iff pcbnew GetUnconnectedCount(False) == 0 and the count is not at a tool cap; a kicad-cli count of exactly 499 is its cap
verdict_rules.drc: PASS iff 0 errors at the board's own rules at the weight it would be built at, AND the fab-real count (reported + DRC-invisible population) is 0
verdict_rules.package: PASS iff a package exists, its hole census reconciles, it carries 0 blind/buried drill files, and its bytes are an export of this board
verdict_rules.revision: PASS iff the board's own title-block revision is non-empty and the package agrees
verdict_rules.outline: PASS iff the Edge.Cuts centreline polygon closes and its area is > 0
verdict_rules.finish: PASS iff the copper_finish field is populated; WAIVED where no PCB and no finish callout exist
verdict_rules.orderable: YES iff 0 FAIL cells. A WAIVED cell is a priced quote line, never a defect; it is carried to NOT KNOWN with an owner
verdict_rules.blocking: the single measured number that stops an order today; for a NO row it must occur verbatim in a FAIL cell
